names.legendary: The Chair Nobody Ever Got Up From

lore.common: Keeps the TV remote down the side of its cushion, along with three coins and a raisin.
lore.uncommon: Groans like an old dog whenever someone sits down in it after dinner.
lore.rare: Pulls anyone who sits in it so deep into its cushions that standing up takes two tries and a helper.
lore.epic: Swallowed a whole visiting uncle after Sunday lunch, and he only woke up in time for supper.
lore.legendary: Held a grandad so comfortably for one afternoon that he missed his own birthday party in the next room.

names.legendary: Whirligig the Speed Barber

lore.common: Smells faintly of hair tonic and spins a quarter turn when nobody is looking.
lore.uncommon: Rises one notch every time the pump is pressed, until small customers can see over the mirror.
lore.rare: Spins so smoothly that the customer leaves with a haircut and a mild case of dizziness.
lore.epic: Pumped itself so high one Saturday that the barber had to fetch a stepladder to finish the fringe.
lore.legendary: Spun so fast one Saturday that it gave everyone in the queue a haircut at once, and they all came out looking like the barber.

names.legendary: Lord Squish of the Living Room

lore.common: Rustles loudly whenever anyone shifts their weight, which ruins every quiet bit of a film.
lore.uncommon: Leaks one tiny bead a day, and somehow they always end up in the vacuum cleaner.
lore.rare: Reshapes itself around whoever flops on it, so perfectly that they cannot be extracted.
lore.epic: Split one movie night and covered the whole lounge in beads, and the cat has been hunting them ever since.
lore.legendary: Swallowed a whole birthday party during musical statues, and nobody has moved since, so everyone won.

names.legendary: The Bed That Kept a Whole Family In

lore.common: Keeps its duvet warm long after the alarm, which makes getting up much harder.
lore.uncommon: Hides one sock in its sheets every week and returns it only on wash day.
lore.rare: Grows heavier blankets the moment the alarm clock rings, so nobody can climb out.
lore.epic: Kept two children in it so snugly one Monday that the school rang to ask if it was a holiday.
lore.legendary: Held the whole family in on a snow day, and nobody got up until the dog brought them toast.

names.legendary: Old Ironsides of the Spare Room

lore.common: Creaks loudly every time somebody rolls over, especially at three in the morning.
lore.uncommon: Drops one slat at random, so the mattress sags exactly where somebody's hip goes.
lore.rare: Slides one inch across the room every night, and by Friday it is under the window.
lore.epic: Dropped one inch onto its slats in the middle of a sleepover ghost story, and the room screamed and then giggled till dawn.
lore.legendary: Was carried up so many staircases on house moves that it learned to climb them, and now lets itself into the spare room.

names.legendary: Baroness Doze of the Veranda

lore.common: Sits by the window and invites everyone to lie down for just a moment.
lore.uncommon: Is always covered in cushions, so there is never anywhere left to actually sit.
lore.rare: Turns any quick rest into a two-hour nap, with the sun moving across the floor.
lore.epic: Lured the whole book club into a doze one afternoon, and nobody finished the chapter.
lore.legendary: Was so sunny and inviting that a cat, a gran and a postman all fell asleep on it at once.

names.legendary: The Futon That Folded Itself

lore.common: Is a sofa by day and a bed by night, and never quite comfortable as either.
lore.uncommon: Pinches fingers every time someone tries to fold it the right way.
lore.rare: Flips from sofa to bed halfway through a conversation, with the guest still sitting on it.
lore.epic: Folded up with a visiting cousin inside, and he was only found when he started snoring.
lore.legendary: Unfolded itself into a bed, then a sofa, then a bed again, all through one very confusing night.

names.legendary: The Headboard With a Hundred Buttons

lore.common: Thumps gently against the wall whenever somebody turns over in bed.
lore.uncommon: Holds up pillows so well that the person reading never notices their book slipping.
lore.rare: Pops a padded button off whenever someone leans back to read, straight into their cocoa.
lore.epic: Thumped the wall so hard during one restless night that next door's crooked pictures all hung straight.
lore.legendary: Has so many buttons that a bored child once counted them all night and got a different total each time.

names.legendary: Grand Unfolder of the Lounge

lore.common: Hides a whole bed inside it and only shows it off when there are guests.
lore.uncommon: Has one spring that pokes whoever is sleeping on the left-hand side.
lore.rare: Takes three people and a lot of grunting to pull out, and two to fold back.
lore.epic: Unfolded so fast one night that it knocked the coffee table into the hallway.
lore.legendary: Unfolded so far for one big family visit that it reached the kitchen, and the cousins made toast without getting up.

names.legendary: Old Faithful of the Village Green

lore.common: Waits by the path all year for someone with tired feet and a sandwich.
lore.uncommon: Leaves a faint stripe pattern on the backs of anyone who sits too long.
lore.rare: Draws every pigeon in the park the moment anybody opens a packet of crisps.
lore.epic: Was so comfortable one sunny afternoon that the whole queue for the bus missed it.
lore.legendary: Got up one morning and walked to the seaside, because everyone who sat on it kept saying they wished they were there.

names.legendary: The Shelf With Sixteen Secrets

lore.common: Has a neat square hole for everything and still somehow fills up with odd socks.
lore.uncommon: Spits out one fabric bin whenever someone walks past too quickly.
lore.rare: Rearranges its cubbies overnight, so nobody can ever find the board games.
lore.epic: Dropped every toy bin at once when the toddler pulled the bottom one, and the floor disappeared.
lore.legendary: Hid a lost birthday present in its top corner so well that it was found three birthdays later.

names.legendary: The Screen That Hid a Whole Party

lore.common: Stands in the corner of the bedroom, politely hiding the pile of laundry.
lore.uncommon: Folds itself flat at the worst moment, revealing whoever is changing behind it.
lore.rare: Casts a shadow of whatever is behind it, only bigger and sillier, so the laundry pile looks like a dancing bear.
lore.epic: Fell flat during the school play costume change, and two pirates and a carrot took a very surprised bow.
lore.legendary: Hid an entire surprise party behind it, balloons and all, until the birthday girl walked in.

names.legendary: Leanwell, Prop of the House

lore.common: Leans against the wall at an angle that makes visitors tilt their heads.
lore.uncommon: Holds a row of houseplants that all lean slightly towards the window.
lore.rare: Grows an extra rung whenever someone needs more shelf space, and it is slowly reaching the ceiling.
lore.epic: Was climbed by the cat in one leap, and every plant came down in a shower of soil.
lore.legendary: Has leaned against the same wall for so long that it now holds the wall up as much as the other way round.

names.legendary: Keeper of the Unfinished Crossword

lore.common: Keeps last month's magazines neatly folded beside the armchair.
lore.uncommon: Curls the cover of every new magazine like a croissant, so nothing ever lies flat again.
lore.rare: Hides every new issue under five old ones, so nobody ever reads this week's.
lore.epic: Kept so many magazines that the dentist's waiting room ran out of chairs.
lore.legendary: Has kept a single unfinished crossword so long that three generations have argued over seven down.

names.legendary: The Divider That Made Four Rooms

lore.common: Stands in the middle of the flat, pretending it is a real wall.
lore.uncommon: Always blocks the light from the window just when somebody wants to read.
lore.rare: Splits a room so cleverly that people walk round it twice before finding the sofa.
lore.epic: Was moved once and suddenly the kitchen and bedroom swapped places, and breakfast was served in bed.
lore.legendary: Turned a tiny studio into a castle, a library and a cinema just by being folded the right way.

names.legendary: Grand Marshal of the Front Door

lore.common: Keeps the shoes in neat pairs, until the family comes home all at once.
lore.uncommon: Hides one shoe of every pair at the very back of its lowest shelf.
lore.rare: Smells so strongly of football boots that visitors keep their own shoes on.
lore.epic: Overflowed one wet weekend, and the hallway became a muddy obstacle course.
lore.legendary: Matched forty pairs of wellies after a school trip without getting a single left foot wrong.

names.legendary: Saffronia the Flavourmaker

lore.common: Holds tiny jars of spices, half of which nobody has opened since they were bought.
lore.uncommon: Sneaks the cinnamon next to the chilli every time, so the porridge is a surprise.
lore.rare: Sends a cloud of pepper into the air whenever a jar is pulled out too quickly.
lore.epic: Dropped its whole top shelf into a curry, and the kitchen sneezed for a week.
lore.legendary: Mixed its jars so cleverly one night that it invented a new flavour, and the whole town now puts it on cornflakes.

names.legendary: Clinkety Clank the Drummer

lore.common: Cradles its bottles on their sides like sleeping babies in a row.
lore.uncommon: Clinks loudly every time somebody walks past in heavy shoes.
lore.rare: Rattles so hard when the washing machine spins that the whole kitchen holds its breath.
lore.epic: Shook so much during a party dance that every guest rushed to steady it at once.
lore.legendary: Rattled so musically during one washing machine spin that a passing band signed it up as their drummer.

names.legendary: Umbrellina the Collector

lore.common: Stands by the door and collects drips from every umbrella and walking stick.
lore.uncommon: Opens one umbrella indoors every week, just to see who gets nervous about bad luck.
lore.rare: Keeps umbrellas so damp that they smell like a pond by the next morning.
lore.epic: Held so many umbrellas after a downpour that the guests had to queue to take one home.
lore.legendary: Grew so fond of umbrellas that it started borrowing them from the neighbours, and now owns every brolly in the street.

names.legendary: Topsy Bunkworth

lore.common: Has a top bunk and a bottom bunk, and everyone in the family has an opinion about which is best.
lore.uncommon: Creaks whenever the person on top turns over, waking the person underneath.
lore.rare: Turns bedtime into a whispered chat that goes on long after the light goes off.
lore.epic: Kept two brothers talking so late that they both fell asleep at breakfast with toast in their hands.
lore.legendary: Was so much fun that the parents swapped and slept in it, and the children got the big bed and a lie-in.

names.legendary: Lidwig the Reuniter

lore.common: Leaves its door open just enough for someone to bump their head on it.
lore.uncommon: Creaks its hinges loudly whenever someone sneaks a biscuit after dark.
lore.rare: Opens its door just wide enough for one biscuit, then shuts it on the hand reaching for the second.
lore.epic: Swung open in a gust of wind and knocked a full tray of cups to the floor.
lore.legendary: Collected odd lids for years until one day they all found their boxes at once, and the kitchen has never been so quiet.

names.legendary: The Rack That Never Dropped a Plate

lore.common: Holds wet plates upright while they drip into the sink.
lore.uncommon: Always has one bowl that will not fit in any slot.
lore.rare: Lets plates slide out one by one, clattering into the sink like a falling row of dominoes.
lore.epic: Collapsed under the dinner party dishes, and the washing up began all over again.
lore.legendary: Held every plate from a wedding feast without a single crack, then asked for the cutlery too.

names.legendary: Shinbane the Wanderer

lore.common: Sits in the middle of the lounge, holding mugs, books and somebody's feet.
lore.uncommon: Gains a fresh ring stain every time somebody forgets a coaster.
lore.rare: Moves two inches in the night, so everyone stubs a toe on it in the morning.
lore.epic: Grew so many mug rings over one rainy weekend that a visitor tried to play darts on it.
lore.legendary: Moved so far one night that it ended up in next door's lounge, and nobody there noticed for a week.

names.legendary: The Cot That Raised Four Babies

lore.common: Holds a sleeping baby and a toy rabbit that nobody is allowed to move.
lore.uncommon: Rattles its bars whenever the baby wants to be picked up again.
lore.rare: Rocks so gently that the parent leaning over it falls asleep before the baby.
lore.epic: Held a baby so peacefully that both parents had their first full night of sleep in a year.
lore.legendary: Raised four babies in a row, and every one of them still sleeps better when they hear it creak.

names.legendary: The Table Nobody Could Reach

lore.common: Stands so tall that people have to hop up onto their stools to reach it.
lore.uncommon: Wobbles every time someone rests their elbows on it to tell a story.
lore.rare: Is so high that short guests eat with their chins at the same height as the plates.
lore.epic: Was leaned on by an entire group at once and tipped every glass into the snack bowl.
lore.legendary: Was so tall that a toddler stood under it and declared it a house, and lived there all afternoon.

names.legendary: The Table With Room for One Croissant

lore.common: Is so small that it fits two cups, one plate and nothing else at all.
lore.uncommon: Tilts slightly so that every saucer slides towards the window.
lore.rare: Squeezes into such a tiny corner that people need to climb over it to reach the door.
lore.epic: Held breakfast for four people at once by sheer politeness, and nothing fell off until the jam.
lore.legendary: Squeezed a whole wedding breakfast onto its tiny top, plate by plate, and still had room for one croissant.

names.legendary: Jack of Tables

lore.common: Lives folded behind the door until somebody suggests a game of cards.
lore.uncommon: Has one leg that folds in at the worst moment of every game.
lore.rare: Collapses the instant somebody slaps down a winning hand, hiding all the evidence.
lore.epic: Hosted a game of snap so fierce that it slapped down a card of its own and won.
lore.legendary: Dealt itself a hand one night, and has been beating the whole family at cards ever since.

names.legendary: Slimline Sylvia

lore.common: Stands by the front door, holding keys, letters and one lonely glove.
lore.uncommon: Is so narrow that anything placed on it slides off the back into the gap.
lore.rare: Hides the car keys behind the post every morning, just before the school run.
lore.epic: Held so much post over one holiday that the front door would only open an inch, and the family posted themselves in.
lore.legendary: Kept the hallway so tidy for so long that the hallway was promoted to a second living room.

names.legendary: The Desk That Finished Every Essay

lore.common: Holds a lamp, a pencil pot and a pile of papers that grows every week.
lore.uncommon: Has one drawer that jams halfway, with the stapler trapped inside.
lore.rare: Makes homework take three times longer by hiding the right pen at the back of a drawer.
lore.epic: Collapsed under a mountain of revision notes the night before exams, and the cat slept on the pile.
lore.legendary: Did its owner's homework one night in perfect handwriting, then got a lower mark than usual.

names.legendary: The Table That Drew a Whole Town

lore.common: Tilts its top at an angle so pencils can roll off slowly and politely.
lore.uncommon: Slides the ruler down to the floor every time somebody reaches for an eraser.
lore.rare: Tips so steeply when bumped that every drawing slides into the waste paper basket.
lore.epic: Tilted all the way one day and sent a whole week of plans floating across the office.
lore.legendary: Drew a whole new town without a single mistake, then forgot the roads, and the people are still trying to get out.

names.legendary: Crumbella the Cook

lore.common: Collects crumbs from every slice of toast made on it, and a few from yesterday too.
lore.uncommon: Has one corner where the post, the keys and a lonely onion always end up.
lore.rare: Fills up so fast in the morning that the kettle has to balance on the bread bin.
lore.epic: Held a whole birthday feast at once, and the cake had to wait its turn on the windowsill.
lore.legendary: Made breakfast all by itself one morning: perfect toast, perfect eggs, and a cup of tea for the dog.

names.legendary: The Island Everyone Gathers Round

lore.common: Stands in the middle of the kitchen so everyone has to walk round it to reach the fridge.
lore.uncommon: Gathers the whole family round it at teatime, even when there is a proper table next door.
lore.rare: Pulls snacks off the plate towards whoever is leaning on it, so nobody notices them going.
lore.epic: Hosted homework, a cake bake and a family argument all at once, and the cake won.
lore.legendary: Became so popular that the dining table in the next room has not seen a dinner in three years.

names.legendary: Tinytable, Last of the Line

lore.common: Hides two smaller tables under itself, like a family hiding from visitors.
lore.uncommon: Gets pulled apart for guests and never quite pushed back together again.
lore.rare: Lets the smallest table escape at parties and wander off to a different room.
lore.epic: Produced exactly enough tables for a surprise party, then one more nobody knew existed.
lore.legendary: Kept pulling out tables all through a huge party, and the last one was the size of a stamp, holding a single pea.

names.legendary: The Sawhorse That Was Ridden Like a Pony

lore.common: Stands in the shed on four splayed legs and kicks over the paint tin whenever anyone walks past.
lore.uncommon: Has so many saw marks along its back that it looks like a ruler.
lore.rare: Wobbles at the exact moment a cut is halfway through, so nothing is ever straight.
lore.epic: Held a plank so steady that the whole shed was built in a single weekend.
lore.legendary: Was mistaken for a pony by a small child who rode it into the garden every morning for a whole summer.

names.legendary: The Desk With a Hidden Drawer

lore.common: Folds its writing flap down only when someone has a letter to write.
lore.uncommon: Has a dozen tiny cubbyholes, each holding one stamp, one key or one mystery.
lore.rare: Locks its little drawers by itself and never tells anyone where the key is.
lore.epic: Revealed a hidden drawer one rainy day, full of old postcards that took a whole afternoon to read.
lore.legendary: Hid a secret drawer so well that it found it again by accident, and was so surprised that it slammed shut for a week.

names.legendary: The Desk That Rose Above It All

lore.common: Hums quietly while it rises, as if it is proud of standing up.
lore.uncommon: Stops a little bit too low or a little too high, never quite right.
lore.rare: Raises itself in the middle of a video call, so the camera suddenly shows only a belly.
lore.epic: Went up and down so often one afternoon that the whole office got exercise without trying.
lore.legendary: Rose so high one day that its owner could see over every desk in the building, and was promoted by mistake.

names.legendary: The Desk That Never Let Anyone Sit

lore.common: Makes its owner stand up tall all day and shift from foot to foot.
lore.uncommon: Is always a bit too high for the tea, so mugs are held in both hands.
lore.rare: Makes everyone who uses it so restless that they pace the office during every call.
lore.epic: Locked itself at full height on a Friday, and the team ate lunch round it standing on one leg like flamingos.
lore.legendary: Made one worker stand so proudly that the office threw a party when they finally sat down.

names.legendary: The Bench That Built Everything

lore.common: Is covered in sawdust, scratches and pencil marks from every project ever started.
lore.uncommon: Hides the tape measure under a pile of offcuts every single weekend.
lore.rare: Makes every small job turn into a whole weekend, with three trips to the shop.
lore.epic: Built a birdhouse, a shelf and a go-kart in one weekend, and the birds got the best deal.
lore.legendary: Has built so many things that half the furniture in the house was born on it.

names.legendary: The Chair at the Head of the Table

lore.common: Tucks itself under the table and waits for someone to say dinner is ready.
lore.uncommon: Scrapes so loudly across the floor that the neighbours know when it is mealtime.
lore.rare: Grows one leg slightly shorter whenever there is a guest, so the guest wobbles through the whole dinner.
lore.epic: Was rocked back so far at Sunday lunch that the gravy went everywhere except the plates.
lore.legendary: Pulled itself out for the dog one Sunday, and now the dog sits at the head of the table and expects gravy.

names.legendary: The Table That Seated Everybody

lore.common: Gets cleared of homework, post and a lunchbox just before every meal.
lore.uncommon: Has an extra leaf hidden inside it that nobody remembers how to pull out.
lore.rare: Grows a new wobble every time it is set for an important dinner.
lore.epic: Was extended for a family feast until it reached the garden door and the dog sat at the end.
lore.legendary: Seated thirty relatives at once, with every one of them claiming the best seat.

names.legendary: Rolltop Rupert

lore.common: Keeps envelopes, stamps and a bottle of ink in its little wooden pigeonholes.
lore.uncommon: Rolls its top shut with a loud clatter whenever someone gets close to the bills.
lore.rare: Hides the one important letter behind fifty old ones until the deadline has passed.
lore.epic: Rolled shut on a whole afternoon of tidying, and the papers were in a worse muddle afterwards.
lore.legendary: Swallowed so many bills that it started writing letters of complaint to the companies itself, in ink.

names.legendary: The Dresser That Never Lost a Sock

lore.common: Has one drawer that sticks, and it is always the one with the clean socks.
lore.uncommon: Keeps every jumper folded until someone rummages for the one at the bottom.
lore.rare: Slams a drawer shut on its own the moment someone looks away.
lore.epic: Jammed every drawer at once on a school morning, and the whole family went out in pyjamas.
lore.legendary: Matched every lost sock in the house in one night, including one from next door's washing line.

names.legendary: Lowrider Len

lore.common: Stands low and long against the wall, with a lamp and a bowl of keys on top.
lore.uncommon: Hides the good plates so well that nobody uses them, even at birthdays.
lore.rare: Lets biscuits vanish from its drawer one by one, with no crumbs left behind.
lore.epic: Held a secret snack stash for the whole office until somebody found the chocolate drawer.
lore.legendary: Was so long that the office used it as a bowling lane at the summer party, and it had the best night of its life.

names.legendary: The Hutch Full of Grandma's Cups

lore.common: Shows off its plates on the shelves above, standing them up like proud soldiers.
lore.uncommon: Rattles its cups gently whenever a lorry rumbles past outside.
lore.rare: Rattles a polite warning whenever anyone reaches for the good cups, like a very small burglar alarm.
lore.epic: Shook so hard during a dance in the kitchen that every plate saluted at once.
lore.legendary: Has kept the same row of cups so perfectly that nobody has ever had the nerve to drink from them.

names.legendary: The Sideboard That Held Every Feast

lore.common: Keeps napkins, coasters and candles in drawers nobody opens except at parties.
lore.uncommon: Has one drawer full of takeaway menus from shops that closed years ago.
lore.rare: Fills up with buffet dishes until nobody can tell where it ends and the food begins.
lore.epic: Held the whole party buffet so proudly that the guests applauded it before eating.
lore.legendary: Has carried so many celebration spreads that it now hums a little tune whenever the cake arrives.

names.legendary: The Cabinet That Filed Everything

lore.common: Keeps papers in alphabetical order, apart from the ones it doesn't like.
lore.uncommon: Clangs loudly whenever a drawer is slammed shut after a long meeting.
lore.rare: Locks its bottom drawer from the inside whenever anyone says the word urgent.
lore.epic: Jammed all four drawers at once on deadline day, and the office worked from the floor.
lore.legendary: Filed every paper in the building so perfectly that it filed the staff too, alphabetically, by lunchtime.

names.legendary: Snapwing the Flying Seat

lore.common: Hides in the shed all winter and comes out in summer with a spider who refuses to leave.
lore.uncommon: Pinches the fingers of anyone who tries to fold it too quickly.
lore.rare: Folds itself shut halfway through a speech, sitting the speaker down suddenly.
lore.epic: Collapsed with a loud snap at a garden party, and the guests thought it was a firework.
lore.legendary: Was so light and snappy that the wind took it off the beach, across the bay, and it opened itself up on the other side.

names.legendary: Lady Velvet of the Four Posts

lore.common: Hides its sleeper behind curtains and pretends it is a castle every night.
lore.uncommon: Rattles its curtains when the window is open, like a ghost that forgot its lines.
lore.rare: Draws its curtains so tightly that nobody inside notices it is morning.
lore.epic: Kept a whole family asleep until lunchtime on a holiday, and nobody complained.
lore.legendary: Closed its curtains so tight on a stormy night that it sailed off like a ship and was docked at the seaside by breakfast.

names.legendary: Sir Splat of the Kitchen

lore.common: Holds a hungry baby and a spoon that gets dropped on the floor every minute.
lore.uncommon: Gets a coat of mashed carrot on its tray at every lunch.
lore.rare: Turns every bowl of food into a game of catch that only the dog wins.
lore.epic: Launched a whole bowl of peas across the kitchen and painted the fridge green.
lore.legendary: Flicked a spoonful of yoghurt so far that it hit a dog in the next street, who came round for more.

names.legendary: Dapplejack the Seafarer

lore.common: Rocks back and forth quietly in the corner, waiting for a small rider.
lore.uncommon: Has a mane that has been brushed so much that only a few hairs are left.
lore.rare: Rocks so fast with a giggling rider that it slowly gallops across the room.
lore.epic: Rocked so wildly at a birthday party that the cake slid off the table and landed perfectly on the cat.
lore.legendary: Rocked so far one night that it really reached the seaside, and came home with sand in its mane and a donkey friend.

names.legendary: The Net That Kept Every Bite Away

lore.common: Hangs over the bed like a soft white tent that keeps the buzzing outside.
lore.uncommon: Always has one tiny hole that a single mosquito finds by midnight.
lore.rare: Traps a buzzing insect inside with its sleeper, which is worse than having no net at all.
lore.epic: Kept a whole family safe on a hot summer night, and the mosquitoes gave up and went home.
lore.legendary: Held off so many buzzing insects on one trip that they started following someone else's tent.

names.legendary: Toastbar the Folder

lore.common: Keeps the towels warm and slightly damp in the corner of the bathroom.
lore.uncommon: Always has one towel hanging at a slant that slides off in the night.
lore.rare: Gets so hot that the towels on it smell like toast by the morning.
lore.epic: Got so hot one winter morning that the bathroom turned into a sauna, and Grandad refused to come out.
lore.legendary: Hung one towel up so neatly that it never needed folding again, and the airing cupboard went on strike.

names.legendary: The Locker That Opened First Try

lore.common: Clangs loudly every time its door is slammed between lessons.
lore.uncommon: Hides a gym kit in its bottom that nobody has washed since September.
lore.rare: Forgets its combination every Monday, so its owner must ask the caretaker.
lore.epic: Jammed with every book in it on exam morning, and the whole corridor helped pull it open.
lore.legendary: Opened so smoothly one exam morning that every locker in the school opened with it, and the corridor rained PE kits.

names.legendary: Bedside Benedict

lore.common: Holds a lamp, a glass of water and a book that has been half read for months.
lore.uncommon: Knocks over the water glass whenever a hand reaches for the alarm clock.
lore.rare: Hides the phone charger so well that nobody can find it in the dark.
lore.epic: Woke the whole house when its alarm went off at three in the morning by mistake.
lore.legendary: Caught a falling alarm clock, a phone and a glass of water in one night without spilling a drop, like a sleepy juggler.

names.legendary: The Table at Every Picnic

lore.common: Has a bench on each side and a sticky patch that never quite comes off.
lore.uncommon: Leaves a splinter in someone's leg every summer, no matter who sits where.
lore.rare: Attracts every wasp in the park the moment a jam sandwich comes out.
lore.epic: Held a family barbecue so big that sausages were served on the benches too.
lore.legendary: Hosted a picnic so polite that the ants formed a queue and the wasps waited to be offered a sandwich.

names.legendary: The Table That Played a Perfect Game

lore.common: Has one leg propped on a folded birthday card, so every single ball drifts to the left.
lore.uncommon: Leaves blue chalk dust on every shirt that leans against it.
lore.rare: Rolls every ball just past the pocket when somebody is about to win.
lore.epic: Sent the white ball flying off the table during a big game and into the fish tank.
lore.legendary: Once played a perfect game by itself, potting every ball with one shot.

names.legendary: Grandmother Tock

lore.common: Rocks gently on the porch even when nobody is sitting in it.
lore.uncommon: Creaks in perfect time with every story that grandad tells.
lore.rare: Rocks anyone who sits in it so gently that they fall asleep mid-sentence.
lore.epic: Rocked so peacefully at a barbecue that the whole party took a nap in the sun.
lore.legendary: Rocked so evenly that a passing orchestra used it to keep time, and it is now the band's oldest member.

names.legendary: The Safe Nobody Could Open

lore.common: Sits heavy in the corner with a dial that clicks satisfyingly when turned.
lore.uncommon: Forgets its own combination after a long holiday, which is very inconvenient.
lore.rare: Hides important papers so well that even their owner needs a detective to find them.
lore.epic: Locked itself on the day of the house sale, and the estate agent spent an hour on the dial.
lore.legendary: Kept a grandmother's birthday surprise so safe that it was only opened at her hundredth birthday.

names.legendary: Snugglebear the Hibernator

lore.common: Rolls up neatly in the shop and never fits back into its bag again.
lore.uncommon: Catches its zip on the lining every time someone tries to get out in a hurry.
lore.rare: Turns anyone inside it into a caterpillar that wriggles across the tent floor.
lore.epic: Kept a scout so snug during a storm that they slept through the tent blowing away.
lore.legendary: Zipped up so snugly on a mountain that its owner slept all winter and woke in spring next to a very confused bear.

names.legendary: The Stool That Reached the Top Shelf

lore.common: Sits at the counter on three legs and wobbles like it is nervous.
lore.uncommon: Spins a quarter turn every time someone sits down on it.
lore.rare: Grows a few inches for anyone short who sits on it, and shrinks a few for everyone else.
lore.epic: Wobbled so nervously at a kitchen party that every guest held their drink with both hands, just in case.
lore.legendary: Helped someone reach the very top shelf and rescue a cake tin lost for ten years.

names.legendary: Her Majesty of the Dressing-Up Box

lore.common: Is far too grand for the room it is in, and everybody knows it.
lore.uncommon: Makes anyone who sits in it sit up straight and use their best manners.
lore.rare: Turns whoever sits on it bossy, until they start ordering tea for the whole room.
lore.epic: Was sat on by a toddler at a party, and the whole family had to bow before cake.
lore.legendary: Made a small child queen for a day, and she ruled the garden with a wooden spoon and kindness.

names.legendary: The Wardrobe With a Hidden Corner

lore.common: Keeps clothes on hangers and drops one jumper on the floor every week.
lore.uncommon: Creaks its doors at night so that small children check for monsters.
lore.rare: Swallows whole outfits at the back until they come back in fashion again.
lore.epic: Hid a child so well in a game of hide-and-seek that the family made tea and waited.
lore.legendary: Has a corner so deep that it once gave back a coat missing since the 1990s, with a ticket still in the pocket.

names.legendary: The Chair That Raced the Marathon

lore.common: Rolls smoothly along the pavement with its rider steering the way.
lore.uncommon: Clicks its brakes on and off with a satisfying snap at every kerb.
lore.rare: Takes ramps so fast that the people walking beside it have to jog to keep up.
lore.epic: Zoomed down the school corridor so quickly that the bell rang late to catch up.
lore.legendary: Carried its rider through a whole marathon, with the crowd cheering every single mile.

names.legendary: Flickwell the Bedmaker

lore.common: Covers the bed neatly and hides the messy sheets underneath.
lore.uncommon: Slides off onto the floor in the night, one corner at a time.
lore.rare: Makes any bed look so tidy that nobody guesses it was made in ten seconds.
lore.epic: Covered a whole pile of laundry so well that guests thought it was a very lumpy bed.
lore.legendary: Made a bed so perfectly in one flick that the hotel down the road tried to hire it as a manager.

names.legendary: The Seat With a Secret Store

lore.common: Sits under the window with a cushion and a view of the whole street.
lore.uncommon: Hides wellies, board games and a lost cat toy under its lifting lid.
lore.rare: Makes anyone sitting on it forget their chores and watch the clouds instead.
lore.epic: Hid every board game in the house under its lid, and the rainy day was saved.
lore.legendary: Lifted its lid one rainy day and gave back a whole lost summer: buckets, spades and a sandcastle still standing.

names.legendary: Snugglesworth the Hugger

lore.common: Lies along the whole length of the bed like a soft, patient sausage.
lore.uncommon: Slowly takes over more of the bed every night until its owner is clinging to the edge.
lore.rare: Wraps itself round anyone who sleeps near it and refuses to let go until morning.
lore.epic: Stole the whole bed one night, and its owner woke up on the rug with a single sock.
lore.legendary: Was hugged so hard on a stormy night that it hugged back, and its owner has never slept better or been so squashed.

names.legendary: Catnapolis, Bed of Strangers

lore.common: Sits in a warm corner, round and soft and almost always completely empty.
lore.uncommon: Is ignored by the cat, who prefers the cardboard box it arrived in.
lore.rare: Becomes the best bed in the world the moment the dog lies down in it.
lore.epic: Was finally used by the cat after six months, and the whole family tiptoed around for a week.
lore.legendary: Was slept in by every cat on the street in one afternoon, and none of them was the family's own.

names.legendary: Countess Lounge of the Parlour

lore.common: Is half sofa, half bed, and perfect for lying back with one hand on the forehead.
lore.uncommon: Makes anyone who sits on it put their feet up and sigh dramatically.
lore.rare: Turns every short sit-down into a long afternoon of staring at the ceiling.
lore.epic: Caused a whole tea party to swoon at once, and the sandwiches went uneaten.
lore.legendary: Has been lounged on so elegantly that even the dog strikes a pose when he jumps on it.

names.legendary: The Bench That Seated Two Hundred

lore.common: Runs the full width of a high old hall and creaks when the end person sits down.
lore.uncommon: Is polished so shiny that people slide along it whenever someone shuffles in.
lore.rare: Squeaks so loudly in a quiet moment that the whole room turns to look.
lore.epic: Slid a whole row of visitors to one end at once, and nobody could stop laughing.
lore.legendary: Has seated so many people at weddings and concerts that its wood is worn into perfect seat shapes.

names.legendary: The Rack That Held Every Coat

lore.common: Stands by the door with its arms out, waiting for wet coats.
lore.uncommon: Grabs scarves by the end and won't let them go when someone is in a hurry.
lore.rare: Holds so many coats that the right one is always underneath the other five.
lore.epic: Toppled over under winter coats, and the hallway looked like a woolly mountain.
lore.legendary: Kept every coat for a whole wedding party and returned each one to the right guest.

names.legendary: Puffington the Boilerbeater

lore.common: Lies puffy and soft on the bed like a cloud that has come in to rest.
lore.uncommon: Gets pulled to one side every night until one sleeper is left out in the cold.
lore.rare: Makes anyone underneath it forget about breakfast, school and alarm clocks.
lore.epic: Hid three children and a dog so well on a rainy Sunday that their parents searched the garden.
lore.legendary: Kept a family so warm one winter that they turned the heating off, and the boiler wrote them a sad letter.

names.legendary: The Cover That Fit Every Cushion

lore.common: Hugs its cushion neatly until somebody sits on the zip side.
lore.uncommon: Always slides round so the zip faces out and scratches someone's arm.
lore.rare: Makes a plain cushion look so fancy that guests are afraid to lean on it.
lore.epic: Was swapped onto every cushion in the house in one tidy-up, and none of them matched.
lore.legendary: Fitted every cushion ever made, round, square and star-shaped, like it was tailored for each.

names.legendary: The Deckchair Nobody Could Open

lore.common: Sits on the beach in bright stripes, sagging comfortably in the sun.
lore.uncommon: Folds the wrong way first, every single time it is opened.
lore.rare: Leans back one notch further every ten minutes until its sitter is lying flat, staring at the sky.
lore.epic: Folded up with a sunbather in it, and he spent the afternoon like a striped sandwich.
lore.legendary: Was so stubborn that a whole beach gathered to watch, and cheered when it finally opened.

names.legendary: The Chair With a Name on Its Back

lore.common: Folds up flat with a canvas back that has somebody's name printed on it.
lore.uncommon: Makes anyone sitting in it shout "action" for no good reason.
lore.rare: Gives its sitter the urge to tell everyone else where to stand.
lore.epic: Directed a whole family photo for an hour, and the dog still looked the wrong way.
lore.legendary: Has had so many famous names on its back that it has started to sign autographs.

names.legendary: The Bed That Smelled Like Home

lore.common: Has a dent in its middle shaped exactly like the dog.
lore.uncommon: Gets spun round three times before every nap, which makes it dizzy.
lore.rare: Hides chewed toys, socks and the TV remote under its soft fleece.
lore.epic: Was found full of everyone's missing slippers after the dog had a busy week.
lore.legendary: Smells so much like home that the dog carried it on holiday and slept in it on the beach.

names.legendary: The Chair That Spun Out a Design

lore.common: Is so tall that its sitter needs the foot ring to climb up.
lore.uncommon: Spins slowly round whenever someone forgets to hold the desk.
lore.rare: Rolls away the moment its sitter leans back to admire their drawing.
lore.epic: Spun round so fast during a brainstorm that its sitter invented three new ideas.
lore.legendary: Has helped draw so many buildings that its wheels have grooves shaped like town maps.

names.legendary: The Cover That Went On First Time

lore.common: Has four corners that can never be found when the duvet needs to go inside.
lore.uncommon: Swallows socks, pyjamas and pillowcases in the wash and keeps them in its corner.
lore.rare: Turns itself inside out during the night, so its sleeper wakes up inside the cover with the duvet on top.
lore.epic: Swallowed its owner whole during a cover change, and they had to crawl out the other end.
lore.legendary: Went onto the duvet first time, all four corners, and the whole family ran to watch.

names.legendary: The Chair That Hatched a Reader

lore.common: Curls round its sitter like a half-cracked egg with a cushion inside.
lore.uncommon: Is so deep that small children vanish into it completely.
lore.rare: Muffles every noise outside so well that its sitter forgets the world exists.
lore.epic: Kept a teenager inside for a whole weekend, and their parents passed in snacks.
lore.legendary: Hatched a book lover who read every book in the library from inside it.

names.legendary: The Mask That Brought the Night

lore.common: Covers its wearer's eyes and makes even midday feel like midnight.
lore.uncommon: Slips up onto the forehead halfway through every nap.
lore.rare: Makes its wearer so sleepy that they forget to take it off before answering the door.
lore.epic: Gave a whole plane full of passengers the best sleep of their lives on one long flight.
lore.legendary: Brought night so perfectly that its wearer slept through a whole summer festival.

names.legendary: Summit Sally

lore.common: Snaps open in one go and is barely big enough for half of anyone.
lore.uncommon: Sinks slowly into soft ground until its sitter is nearly sitting on the grass.
lore.rare: Folds up the moment someone leans forward to grab a sandwich.
lore.epic: Opened itself in the car boot on the way to the beach, and the family arrived with a stool where the picnic should be.
lore.legendary: Was carried up a mountain and opened at the very top, so for one minute it was the highest seat in the country.

names.legendary: Slippersworth the Idle

lore.common: Sits by the armchair waiting for tired feet to arrive at the end of the day.
lore.uncommon: Gets moved by everyone and ends up exactly where someone will trip on it.
lore.rare: Makes any feet that rest on it so relaxed that the slippers fall off on their own.
lore.epic: Had so many feet put up on it at a party that it relaxed completely and started snoring under the slippers.
lore.legendary: Put its own feet up one evening, and the armchair had to make the tea.

names.legendary: The Hammock Nobody Climbed Out Of

lore.common: Swings lazily between two trees, waiting for someone with a book.
lore.uncommon: Flips its sitter onto the grass when they climb in from the wrong side.
lore.rare: Sways so gently that anyone inside forgets what they were supposed to be doing.
lore.epic: Kept a whole family napping in turns all afternoon, and nobody mowed the lawn.
lore.legendary: Swung someone to sleep at noon, and they woke up at sunset with leaves in their hair.

names.legendary: The Chair That Spun the Summer Away

lore.common: Hangs from a hook and turns slowly in the breeze like a lazy pendulum.
lore.uncommon: Collects every leaf, petal and lost tennis ball that drifts past, and gives them to whoever sits down next.
lore.rare: Twirls so smoothly that its sitter gets a little dizzy just reading a magazine.
lore.epic: Swayed so gently that a robin landed on it for a rest and rode it for a whole afternoon.
lore.legendary: Twirled its way through a whole summer holiday without anyone ever wanting to get out.

names.legendary: The Stand That Wore Every Hat

lore.common: Stands in the hall wearing three hats at once and looking very pleased with itself.
lore.uncommon: Leans slightly to the left when a heavy coat is thrown at it.
lore.rare: Steals the hat of anyone who walks past, and gives it back only when they leave.
lore.epic: Wore every hat in the house at once on a windy day, and toppled into the porch.
lore.legendary: Has worn so many hats over the years that it now nods politely to anyone who passes.

names.legendary: Toastina, Friend of Snowmen

lore.common: Glugs and wobbles when filled, then makes cold feet happy for hours.
lore.uncommon: Always ends up at the bottom of the bed by morning, completely cold.
lore.rare: Stays so cosy that cats queue to sit on it the moment it is put down.
lore.epic: Warmed a whole bed so well on a snowy night that nobody wanted to get up for school.
lore.legendary: Got so cosy one snowy night that the snowman outside knocked on the window to ask for a go.

names.legendary: The Chair That Fixed Every Slouch

lore.common: Makes its sitter kneel forward, as if they are about to sprint.
lore.uncommon: Leaves red marks on the knees after a long day at the desk.
lore.rare: Makes anyone who uses it sit so straight that they look like a tiny soldier.
lore.epic: Fixed a whole office's slouch in a week, and the managers ordered ten more.
lore.legendary: Corrected so many slouches that it once straightened a dog that sat in it by mistake.

names.legendary: The Topper That Made Every Bed Perfect

lore.common: Lies on top of the mattress, adding a soft layer that nobody can see.
lore.uncommon: Slides off one side so slowly that nobody notices until the floor is comfier.
lore.rare: Makes any bed so deep and soft that its sleeper sinks into a perfect body shape.
lore.epic: Turned a creaky old guest bed into the best bed in the house, and the guests never left.
lore.legendary: Has made so many beds comfortable that one hotel tried to book it for a whole year.

names.legendary: The Pillow That Went Round the World

lore.common: Wraps round its wearer's neck and keeps their head from nodding on the bus.
lore.uncommon: Gets left behind on every coach, plane and train it goes on.
lore.rare: Makes its wearer so sleepy that they miss their stop by three stations.
lore.epic: Helped a whole coach sleep through a twelve-hour drive, and the driver was the only one awake.
lore.legendary: Has travelled round the world in someone's luggage without missing a single nap.

names.legendary: The Ottoman That Hid the Presents

lore.common: Pretends to be a footstool while hiding blankets and games inside its lid.
lore.uncommon: Squishes down when anyone sits on it, even though it is not meant to be a seat.
lore.rare: Swallows anything left on top, so it ends up full of glasses, socks and lost toys.
lore.epic: Hid every birthday present so well that the party nearly started without them.
lore.legendary: Opened its lid one evening and out came a lost cat, a lost dog and the uncle who popped round for tea in March.

names.legendary: Bowlbert the Bottomless

lore.common: Is a giant bowl of a chair with a cushion that swallows anyone who sits down.
lore.uncommon: Tilts backwards when someone tries to stand up, so they slide right back in.
lore.rare: Pulls its cushion over anyone who dozes off, like a lid, and they wake up feeling like a pie.
lore.epic: Fit three friends and a cat inside it at a sleepover, and nobody wanted to move.
lore.legendary: Was so deep that a teenager went in looking for the remote and came out an hour later with three remotes and a lost hamster.

names.legendary: Ironside the Improved

lore.common: Has a small plaque on its back with a name and a few kind words.
lore.uncommon: Is always warm on one side and freezing cold on the other.
lore.rare: Shuffles itself into the only shade on a hot day and into the only puddle on a wet one.
lore.epic: Was so popular on the first sunny day that a queue formed to sit on it.
lore.legendary: Was sat on by so many tired walkers that it grew a footrest, then a cup holder, and finally a little roof.

names.legendary: Snoozeheap, Bed of Truce

lore.common: Is covered in so much fur that it looks like it is growing its own.
lore.uncommon: Gets dragged across the room to the sunniest spot on the floor.
lore.rare: Is fought over by the cat, the dog and the hamster, and none of them win.
lore.epic: Was dragged next to the radiator and got so warm that every pet slept in it at once.
lore.legendary: Was so cosy that a fox crept in one winter night, and the family found it curled up next to the cat, both snoring.

names.legendary: Maestro Squeakins

lore.common: Hides piles of sheet music under its lid, all in the wrong order.
lore.uncommon: Squeaks loudly at every quiet moment in a piece, which ruins the mood.
lore.rare: Wobbles whenever someone plays a loud note, so the pianist must hold on tight.
lore.epic: Squeaked so loudly in a school concert that the audience laughed before the final chord.
lore.legendary: Squeaked one note so perfectly in a concert that the orchestra tuned to it.

names.legendary: The Pouffe That Rolled Away

lore.common: Sits in the lounge, round and squashy, ready for feet or a small person.
lore.uncommon: Sinks a little lower every time anyone sits on it, and is slowly turning into a rug.
lore.rare: Escapes across the room when a child jumps on it, carrying them like a raft.
lore.epic: Rolled down the hallway with the cat on top, and the cat looked very pleased.
lore.legendary: Rolled out of the front door on a windy day and was last seen bowling along the beach, with the seagulls cheering.

names.legendary: The Chair That Rode Into Work

lore.common: Looks like a horse saddle on a pole and makes its sitter sit very upright.
lore.uncommon: Is mistaken for a bike seat by everyone who sees it for the first time.
lore.rare: Makes its sitter feel like a cowboy, and they start calling the printer partner.
lore.epic: Turned a quiet office into a rodeo the day everyone got one, and nobody stopped spinning.
lore.legendary: Was ridden to work so proudly that the whole office started wearing cowboy hats.

names.legendary: The Mask That Hid the Dawn

lore.common: Has two tiny stitched eyes on the front that look wide awake.
lore.uncommon: Gets lost in the bedsheets every morning and turns up a week later.
lore.rare: Shows its wearer the dream before they fall asleep, so they always know how it ends.
lore.epic: Let a whole family sleep in on a bright summer morning until the ice cream van came by.
lore.legendary: Kept the dawn out so well that the cockerel next door overslept too, and the whole farm had a lie-in.

names.legendary: Littlelift the Lofty

lore.common: Has two steps and a small handle, and waits in the kitchen for short people.
lore.uncommon: Is always in the wrong room when somebody needs to reach a high shelf.
lore.rare: Folds itself up the moment nobody is using it and hides behind the fridge.
lore.epic: Helped a child reach the biscuit tin, and the whole family heard the lid pop.
lore.legendary: Gave a small child just enough height to see over the garden fence, and she has been in charge of the street ever since.

names.legendary: Spindrift the Driller

lore.common: Spins round on one leg and squeaks a little at the end of each turn.
lore.uncommon: Squeaks on every spin, and plays a different note for every person who sits on it.
lore.rare: Spins so freely that children use it as a ride and adults secretly do too.
lore.epic: Spun so long at a kitchen party that it unscrewed itself and rose slowly towards the ceiling.
lore.legendary: Spun so fast that it drilled down into the cellar and came back up with a jar of jam nobody knew was there.

names.legendary: Drapella the Flying

lore.common: Lies over the arm of the sofa, ready to be pulled over someone's knees.
lore.uncommon: Gets claimed by the cat before anyone else can use it.
lore.rare: Makes anyone who wraps up in it refuse to get up even for a cup of tea.
lore.epic: Kept a whole family warm when the heating broke, and nobody noticed for a day.
lore.legendary: Was thrown over the sofa so gracefully that it floated, and the cat rode it round the lounge like a flying carpet.

names.legendary: The Stool Before Every Big Night

lore.common: Sits in front of the mirror, padded and patient, waiting for someone to get ready.
lore.uncommon: Hides one earring under its cushion every week and gives it back on a Tuesday.
lore.rare: Makes getting ready take twice as long by being far too comfortable to leave.
lore.epic: Was sat on so long before a party that everyone else had already left without them.
lore.legendary: Got someone ready so beautifully for a party that the mirror asked for a photo.
